recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 可見毛囊漏斗部（角質填充）周圍與真皮中密集的淋巴球浸潤，以小淋巴球為主，表皮僅有輕微淋巴球外滲，無明顯 Pautrier 微膿瘍；毛囊周圍的真皮小淋巴球密集浸潤符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的表現。
features: Dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate surrounding a keratin-filled follicular infundibulum
Infiltrate composed predominantly of small, dark lymphocytes with scattered slightly larger cells
Thin band of papillary dermal collagen separates much of the infiltrate from the epidermis
Mild lymphocyte exocytosis into the follicular epithelium without Pautrier microabscesses
Overlying epidermis with orthokeratosis, otherwise unremarkable
describe_en: H&E section of skin shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate surrounding a keratin-filled follicular infundibulum and extending into the adjacent dermis. The infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with scattered slightly larger cells, separated from the epidermis in most areas by a thin band of papillary dermal collagen. There is only mild lymphocyte exocytosis into the follicular epithelium, without Pautrier microabscesses, necrosis or ulceration. Findings are consistent with a dense small-cell dermal lymphoid infiltrate compatible with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, pending immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Folliculotropic MF shows atypical T cells infiltrating the follicular epithelium, often with follicular mucinosis, and multiple follicle-based plaques clinically.
Pseudolymphoma typically has a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, plasma cells and germinal centers and polyclonal T cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: The marginal zone entity is B-cell predominant with monocytoid cells and monotypic plasma cells, which IHC for CD20 and light chains reveals.
